notes.title: Update 1.1.4
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28071282/1c8d0fd19b6c710d977f14ae6ed3878a0d495410.png[/img]

What's new, Reaper?

*Work in Hell. Now it is more difficult. Use both Devourers or you lose.

*Maximum 10 clients in 1 catastrophe. Old bug fixed ːfndː

*It is easier to get better rating on the end of the game. Easier, but not too easy ːkotː

*New 'Special guest' screen, some add-on preparations.
